name: Pareflog
description: Cut short and hard from a tucked elbow while the bodies are chest to chest.

name: Lurching Peel
description: Stab upward from a tucked elbow into the ribs or underarm of a close opponent.

name: Stalling Trim
description: Hook the heel of the blade inside the opponent's wrist and draw it off line.

name: Plungehasp
description: Cover the throat and chest with the forearm and flat blade at clinch range.

name: Fleet Pare
description: Slip the body off the attacker's line with a short side step while staying inside reach.

name: Vicious Thumbramp
description: Thread qi through the edge and slice across an opponent held at clinch range.

name: Slitscorer
description: Drive the tip into a gap while the other arm locks the opponent's weapon arm in place.

name: Gripping Buttcap
description: Flash the open hand toward the face and cut beneath it as the eyes follow.

name: Cramping Shave
description: Pull the opponent's sleeve with the free hand to open the line for the blade.

name: Choil Scorer
description: Shove with the palm and let the edge follow the stumbling body in one flow.

name: Viselike Lanyard
description: Pin the opponent's hand against their body and slice along the trapped forearm.

name: Rooted Bolster
description: Raise the empty hand beside the blade to cover the face against a thrown strike.

name: Edgebelly Buckle
description: Pass the knife from hand to hand mid-stroke so the cut arrives from the other side.

name: Grim Plunge
description: Hide the blade behind the free hand and cut upward with qi through the gap.

name: Pareslap
description: Surge qi to the tip and thrust forward while the palm covers the thrust line.

name: Rough Whittle
description: Slip inside a swing and cut the exposed arm in the same motion.

name: Savage Scales
description: Step to the outside of a thrust and stab the flank behind the weapon arm.

name: Swedgebarrier
description: Check the opponent's weapon arm with the flat as the user steps into range.

name: Shaveglide
description: Skip forward off the back foot to cross the gap before the opponent resets.

name: Pirouetting Pare
description: Pulse qi into the legs to cover the gap and cut as the feet land.

name: Lurching Tangpin
description: Cut in rapid downward strokes while stepping inside the opponent's guard at each pace.

name: Bold Slit
description: Cut once cleanly across the exposed neck or arm of a faltering opponent.

name: Scalesscorer
description: Drive the point onward after a missed cut to punish an opponent who has dodged short.

name: Scudding Peel
description: Glide behind a retreating opponent on quiet feet and keep the same distance.

name: Padded Scales
description: Turn blows aside with short flat movements that suit cramped brush or narrow lanes.

name: Lurching Whittle
description: Sever a tight cord or line holding the user in one stroke of the edge.

name: Alert Plunge
description: Watch the opponent's breathing and stride for signs of fatigue or injury.

name: Brisk Lanyard
description: Cut across a runner's path with qi boosting the stride and the edge together.

name: Fierce Buttcap
description: Wait motionless and stab upward the moment the opponent steps within the blade's reach.

name: Swedge Swat
description: Sustain a running pursuit with qi in the legs and light cuts at every pass.

name: Choilthwack
description: Cut straight downward from the guard with a firm wrist and the edge square.

name: Keen Trim
description: Cut upward along the centerline from low guard to under the opponent's chin.

name: Shaveswat
description: Drop the edge diagonally from the shoulder across the opponent's collar line.

name: Keen Slit
description: Thrust along a straight line from hip to target with the arm fully extended.

name: Plungeprop
description: Parry the blow with the flat then return the edge across the opponent's wrist.

name: Tangpin Curl
description: Slide the lead foot out and bring the back foot after it to avoid a straight blow.

name: Choilbuckle
description: Hold the tip at the opponent's throat line to freeze their advance for a moment.

name: Fierce Bolster
description: Raise the knife overhead and bring it down with qi gathered in the forearm.

name: Dire Swedge
description: Roll the wrist over in a continuous circle to cut twice from one swing.

name: Clutching Swedge
description: Close in with the blade flat against the opponent's weapon arm and bind it tight.

name: Gallpeel
description: Rap the spine across the back of the hand to make it release a weapon.

name: Draught Thumbramp
description: Lead with the edge and draw it back across the target in one smooth pull.

name: Lanyard Buckle
description: Lever the spine against the opponent's wrist to press their weapon arm down.

name: Rooted Edgebelly
description: Flip the blade so the spine meets the blow and the edge turns back for a cut.

name: Staticswedge
description: Slap the flat across the opponent's guard hand to knock it from the centerline.

name: Stern Bolster
description: Drive the spine down on a forearm or collarbone with qi weighting the blow.

name: Statictrim
description: Hammer with the spine then roll the blade over and slice back along the same line.

name: Static Whittle
description: Rock the blade tip on the target in rapid chops that follow one another without pause.

name: Brawn Peel
description: Slice forward then slide the edge sideways along the target to widen the wound.

name: Shard Tangpin
description: Jab the point in quick short bursts toward one spot on the opponent's guard.

name: Regimen Choil
description: Raise the broad flat as a shield and absorb a blow on the whole width of the blade.

name: Grit Choil
description: Step off the opponent's beat so the next cut lands between their strokes.

name: Candor Thumbramp
description: Read the whole room at a glance for the nearest threat and the nearest exit.

name: Clayslit
description: Double the pace of the chops by pulsing qi through the wrist with each stroke.

name: Claypare
description: Spin the knife in the fingers and catch it for a cut from an unexpected angle.

name: Draught Buttcap
description: Shave the edge down the opponent's weapon to bite into the fingers behind the guard.

name: Weighty Pare
description: Hook the handle over the opponent's crossguard and pull their weapon off line.

name: Brasspeel
description: Hook the tip into a sleeve and rip it to tangle the weapon arm.

name: Clayplunge
description: Step out of a bind sideways while keeping the blade pressed against the opponent's.

name: Brutal Plunge
description: Wedge the qi-sharpened point between the opponent's hands and pry their guard open.

name: Trimbuckle
description: Lock the opponent's weapon against the crossguard and peel it out of their grip.

name: Honed Shave
description: Open a chain with a quick diagonal cut that leaves the blade ready for the next.

name: Static Slit
description: Return the blade along the same line in the opposite direction for the second link.

name: Scales Flog
description: Cross the earlier two cuts with a level stroke that closes the chain.

name: Draught Trim
description: Step back off the line when a chain is read and cut across the follow-up.

name: Swedgebuckle
description: Slide the blade along the incoming edge and turn it into the next cut.

name: Humscales
description: Count the opponent's strokes aloud in the mind to find where their chain breaks.

name: Embertrim
description: Carry one breath of qi through three connected cuts without letting it break.

name: Grit Pare
description: Bridge two chains with a long step so the cutting never stops.

name: Viselike Edgebelly
description: End a chain by locking the opponent's weapon arm against the body with the blade.

name: Rushing Swedge
description: Probe the opponent's guard hand with a quick light cut to see how it reacts.

name: Attentive Plunge
description: Tap the opponent's wrist with the blade flat to feel the tension in the tendons.

name: Levering Shave
description: Flick the edge across the fingers on a weapon grip to break the hold.

name: Brass Whittle
description: Cut at the moment the opponent shifts grip and the hand is open.

name: Edgebelly Prop
description: Slip a strike aside by reading the wrist turn that comes just before it.

name: Plungezip
description: Step in and out of the opponent's reach to learn how far their blade travels.

name: Fierce Slit
description: Feel the qi shift in the opponent's grip through contact and cut into the opening.

name: Swift Buttcap
description: Rise under a read wrist turn and cut up through the weapon hand.
